nodes.name: COMBINED-EFFECT-TEST-PLAN.docx
nodes.summary: Binary Word document containing the combined-effect test plan for the Waggle memory and GEPA systems, generated by the accompanying generate-combined-plan.mjs script.

nodes.name: generate-combined-plan.mjs
nodes.summary: Node.js ESM script that programmatically generates the COMBINED-EFFECT-TEST-PLAN.docx using the docx library, building 11 structured sections covering the combined Waggle memory and GEPA evaluation protocol with tables, bullet lists, and formatted paragraphs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the docx npm library to construct Word documents programmatically without a template; section builder functions compose document children arrays.

nodes.name: generate-gepa-plan.mjs
nodes.summary: Node.js ESM script generating the GEPA-EVOLUTION-TEST-PLAN.docx using the docx library, with 14 content-section builders covering GEPA evolution evaluation methodology, scoring tables, risk matrices, and success criteria.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest script in the batch at 1502 lines; uses rich text (richPara, richBullet) with inline bold/normal run mixing, and makeTable abstraction handling column widths via convertInchesToTwip.

nodes.name: generate-memory-plan.mjs
nodes.summary: Node.js ESM script generating the MEMORY-HARVEST-TEST-PLAN.docx with a `main` entry point orchestrating 10 named section-builder functions covering the memory harvest test protocol, judge configuration, statistical methods, and appendices.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows a canonical entry-point pattern: all section builders are named descriptively (section4_testProtocol), and main() calls them in sequence before writing via Packer.toBuffer.

nodes.name: GEPA-EVOLUTION-TEST-PLAN.docx
nodes.summary: Binary Word document containing the GEPA evolution test plan generated by generate-gepa-plan.mjs, covering the evaluation methodology for the Waggle agent evolution system.

nodes.name: MEMORY-HARVEST-TEST-PLAN.docx
nodes.summary: Binary Word document containing the memory-harvest test plan generated by generate-memory-plan.mjs, covering the evaluation protocol for Waggle's memory substrate and harvest pipeline.
